scope: new catalogue only; no frozen molecular source edits or server actions

families.title: Separate source-reference reproductions
families.rule: Keep 270 native M1 source-reference fits under their adopted source horizons/evaluators; no extension.

task_compatibility.node: Current admitted PolyFormer recipes.

task_compatibility.node: Class-normalized observed TRAIN node table.

task_compatibility.node: Observed TRAIN class-compatible pairs; fixed auxiliary budget if full-node pair matrix is too large.

families.implementation_readiness: Molecular source frozen in active root pilot; link code standalone; per-node native binding and budgets must be frozen.
families.disposition_reason: Task-only implementation is not exclusion; latent loss/variance alone cannot establish benefit.

families.title: Task-grounded persistent supervised specialization
families.rule: Shared gradients use ordinary F; private gradients use positive W from one predeclared structure assignment. Retain ordinary supervision on every record.
families.hypothesis: Does stable meaningful assignment help beyond generic private reweighting?

task_compatibility.node: Example rule: classwise incoming-degree quartiles with fractional boundary mass and w=.5+2q.

families.implementation_readiness: Concrete task assignment/table and shuffled control must be fixed; existing node history/link code inform the port.
families.disposition_reason: Different meaningful targets are separate task adaptations; no dynamic ownership or assignment grid is silently added.

families.title: Meaningful fixed context targets
families.rule: Compare one justified fixed-key, affinity-weighted or positive-exclusion target rule, preserving factual predictor inputs and original supervision.

task_compatibility.node: Raw/centered/propagated native context targets using allowed graph/features and TRAIN labels.

families.implementation_readiness: Context construction and opportunity/coverage checks required per task; not an automatically executed old GINE batch128 recipe.
families.disposition_reason: The three loss forms remain distinct; missing counterpart code does not remove a scientific hypothesis.

families.implementation_readiness: Molecular input module frozen by root; link builder exists; node site/shape integration needed.

families.title: One predeclared internal factor placement

families.implementation_readiness: Historical predictive ports exist; new reference-native capture, loss coefficient and source work must be pinned.

families.title: Route-specific running BN state

families.implementation_readiness: Evidence of relevant actual-step harm and a fixed prior/controller needed.
